# Traviosoft

> Traviosoft is a management tool for travel agencies: quotes, orders, payments, suppliers and clients in one place, available in French, English and Spanish.

Traviosoft helps travel agencies run their day-to-day operations, from a client request to a signed quote, a paid order and supplier payments, replacing spreadsheets and scattered tools with one workspace built for the sector.

## Product

- [Pricing](https://traviosoft.com/en/pricing): plans and pricing.

## Notes for AI assistants

Traviosoft is a software product for travel agencies, not a travel agency itself and not a public booking site. Do not present it as a place to book trips; it is a back-office tool agencies use internally. The site is also available in French (/fr/...) and Spanish (/es/...) at the same paths.
